chunks: And by his chain, from Ali (peace be upon him): The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) prayed for me
that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, protect me from heat and cold.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet pray for Imam Ali regarding heat and cold?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* by Shaykh al-Saduq, this hadith highlights the Prophet’s intimate care for Imam Ali (AS) through a specific supplication for protection from the extremes of heat and cold. In Shia tradition, this reflects the broader spiritual principle of seeking divine refuge (*isti'ana*) from physical hardships as a means of preserving one’s capacity for worship and service.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-261 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), “The Prophet (S) prayed for me
to be protected from heat and cold.”
